jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. 1 Senior Engineer PCB Development and Verification for Reliability Stress Tests on Modules Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

Collaborate with internal stakeholders and the RPT team to align on

development progress, requirements, and timelines

Simulate and analyze complex circuit designs for advanced hardware

development

Create PCB schematics, layouts, component selections, and stack-up

definitions to develop prototypes

Perform thorough design reviews and comprehensive hardware verifications

Optimize existing test systems actively and define design guidelines for stress

hardware development

Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of hardware failures during

qualification testing

Develop software tools, test scripts, and automation applications for system

control, monitoring, and data collection

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

A Master's or PhD degree in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a comparable

engineering field

Deep knowledge of high-frequency, high-power DC/DC converter topologies

(e.g., Buck, Boost, Flyback, LLC) for SMPS applications

A solid understanding of the theory, selection, and practical application of

magnetics and capacitors

Proven experience in microcontroller programming (such as XMC, C8051)

utilizing C, C++, and LUA

Extensive expertise in high-frequency PCB design, EMC guidelines, circuit

design, and simulation tools like Altium, Cadence, LTSpice, or MATLAB

A natural problem solver characterized by strong analytical thinking and

structured troubleshooting skills

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a

collaborative and proactive approach

Fluency in English is required; German language proficiency is considered a

strong asset

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Financial Accountant (m/f/d) The role

You make sure Fonio's numbers are right and can stand up to auditors and investors. That means owning the monthly and year-end close, and solving tricky questions such as how to account for pay-per-minute revenue across nine markets and more.

As new entities and products launch, you set up the accounting so it scales, rather than patching it later.

What to Expect

 * In-house accounting: Take over accounting from our external provider and build the internal function.

 * Operational ownership: Own day-to-day accounting, including AP/AR, reconciliations, master data and bookkeeping.

 * Monthly close & reporting: Own monthly closing and recurring statutory filings (VAT, ZM, Intrastat, etc.), working closely with our tax advisors.

 * Revenue recognition: make sure usage-based revenue is recognised correctly and consistently.

 * Multi-entity: run intercompany accounting, currencies and consolidation as UK and US entities come online, and integrate acquisitions such as fluently.

 * Controls and policies: write accounting policies and controls that hold up in investor due diligence.

 * Oversight: keep billing, payables and payroll postings accurate, and improve processes and systems as volume grows.

What You Bring

Must-haves

 * 4 to 7 years in accounting, ideally with audit firm training plus time at a tech or SaaS company.

 * Qualified or part-qualified (Bilanzbuchhalter, ACCA, CPA or similar).

 * Has owned month-end and year-end close and statutory accounts under Austrian GAAP (UGB).

 * Confident handling audits and technical accounting questions.

 * Fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

 * Revenue recognition for subscription or usage-based pricing.

 * Multi-entity consolidation, or IFRS exposure.

 * Experience with post-merger integration or investor due diligence.

 * Familiar with modern finance tools (e.g. BMD, DATEV, Xero or Stripe).

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €100,000 + Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture fit

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿
